ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of white to black; approximately 85% low-intensity (near-black) pixels with 15% high-intensity (white) stippled points across the visible field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominantly dark ventral surface with high-frequency stippled white pixels distributed globally. High density of white pixel clusters observed along the basal region near the waterline and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels along the trailing boundary, most prominent on the medial section of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate upward convexity sweeping from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp upward-pointing tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast white pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites. Scattered smaller circular white spots across the central dark field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the right lobe surface, oriented from the leading edge toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and irregular tissue buildup at the distal tips of both lobes; several small white focal lesions scattered across the central ventral area.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged protrusion on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the notch to the tip.
